shortDescription: A whale has an unrealized profit of about $396,000 on a short position of 6 million BULLA on Aster DEX. According to ChainCatcher, Lookonchain data shows wallet 0xC024 opened the 1x-leverage position at a value of about $408,000; its return on investment is 97.21%.
